## Où j'en suis
Keyboard move/resize and focus-ring follow-up for dashboards v2 is done on branch tom/dashboard-keyboard: useGridKeyboard() handles Tab focus, arrow moves, Shift+arrow resize, Enter drop/Escape cancel, aria-live announcements and a 2px focus ring; 11 new tests are green and the mouse-drag regression is fixed, committed as 8f1a2c7. PR #423 is open for Priya. dashboards_v2 is on for Zest on staging; production stays off until the morning of the 24th. The visx migration is abandoned: #401 closed, no @visx/* dependency, all charts on recharts. (source: d4-05, d4-06, c3-03)

- [en-cours] PR kestrel-analytics/platform#423 open for Priya's review and merge (source: d4-05, ses-db-4)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya reviews and merges PR #423 (source: d4-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Flip dashboards_v2 on prod the morning of the 24th (source: d4-06)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit KeyboardSensor on react-grid-layout items: every move applied twice and mouse drag fired two layout changes; fixing it would mean rewriting the grid, so @dnd-kit/core was removed (source: d4-02)
- [décision] dashboards_v2 on for Zest on staging only; production untouched until the morning of the 24th (source: d4-06)
- [décision] Keep recharts and close visx migration PR #401 (source: c3-03)
